args.body: Hi Jonah, sorry for the wait on your boiler (R-4799). Where it stands: the first engineer visited and quoted £780 to replace a part called an expansion vessel, which is likely why the pressure keeps dropping. Your landlord asked for a second quote before agreeing to that spend, and a second company (Swift P&H) is noted to visit on 14 October. We're confirming that date with them and will tell you as soon as it's confirmed. Until then, no repair has been approved. If the boiler is still working, you can carry on topping up the pressure as before. If you lose heating or hot water, or see leaks or smells, tell us straight away. We'll update you again by Wednesday 14 October. On bins: collections are run by Tower Hamlets council, not us, so please check or report a missed collection on their website. I can't see your collection day from here. Anything else, just reply here.
